name: livingruntime-remote
description: Bounded SSH-backed remote development tools for LivingRuntime hosts.

interface.longDescription: A private local development plugin that exposes scoped SSH-backed file, Git, process, service, and log tools without storing SSH passwords or private keys in the plugin.
